limits: The original trainer used Unsloth. This diagnostic compared native Transformers attention implementations, not an actual Unsloth forward pass, so the small residual gap to the rounded original logged loss remains unexplained.
The diagnostic covers one initial accumulation group, not equality of complete training trajectories, final kernels, or evaluation distributions.

Earlier production scripts request SDPA but do not record the automatically selected CUDA kernel. Their hash-verified code establishes the requested attention implementation, not bitwise equivalence to Unsloth.
The report does not isolate whether the eager/SDPA gap comes from score precision, mask handling, or another detail of the attention execution path.
